title: Practice 3: Genitive endings: nouns, adjectives, pronouns

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: У меня много ___ (неженатый) друзей и подруг.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «друзей»: genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: My throat is sore from the secondhand smoke.
exercises.ru: У меня горло болит от ___ курения.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «курения»: genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: У меня закончился наполнитель для ___ (кошачий) туалета.
exercises.prompt: I ran out of cat litter.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «туалета»: genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Fold the napkins and put one by each plate.
exercises.ru: Согни салфетки и положи у ___ тарелки по одной.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «тарелки»: genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Мы сдружились с ___ (сам) начала.
exercises.prompt: We hit it off right off the bat.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «начала»: genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: "Tom died of a heart attack." "Was he vaccinated?"
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «приступа»: genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Хабаровск - один из ___ (крупный) городов Дальнего Востока России.
exercises.prompt: Khabarovsk is among the largest cities of the Russian Far East.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «городов»: genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Don't expect a coherent answer.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «ответа»: genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Я переняла у Тома несколько ___ (плохой) привычек.
exercises.prompt: I learned several bad habits from Tom.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «привычек»: genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Sentences begin with a capital letter.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «буквы»: genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Английский посол потребовал ___ (непосредственный) встречи с президентом.
exercises.prompt: The English ambassador demanded to meet with the President directly.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «встречи»: genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The word "champignon" comes from French.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «языка»: genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Автострада была перекрыта из-за ___ (серьёзный) аварии.
exercises.prompt: The motorway was closed because of a major accident.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «аварии»: genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: There is no greater insult to life than premature ejaculation.
exercises.ru: Нет ___ оскорбления для жизни, чем преждевременная эякуляция.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «оскорбления»: genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Нет ___ (установленный) расписания, которому вы должны следовать.
exercises.prompt: There's no set schedule that you need to follow.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «расписания»: genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: You can't build a house out of rotten logs.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «брёвен»: genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Том съехал из ___ (родительский) дома.
exercises.prompt: Tom moved out of his parents' house.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «дома»: genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: bell hooks doesn’t capitalise her pen name.
exercises.ru: белл хукс пишет свой псевдоним с ___ буквы.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «буквы»: genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Я думаю, у ___ (женатый) людей проблем больше, чем у неженатых.
exercises.prompt: I think married people have more problems than single people.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «людей»: genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: У меня нет ___ (учётный) записи на этих форумах.
exercises.prompt: I do not have an account in these forums.
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «записи»: genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
